layers.title: jet propulsion
layers.adds: momentum flux out of a contracting cavity

checks.name: pumping work equals the jet's kinetic energy
checks.note: p Q = (1/2) rho Q^3/A^2 and (1/2) m_dot ve^2 are the same quantity; both sides are analytic, so this pins the reference

checks.name: the charged pumping work equals p Q integrated
checks.note: JetSet.actuator_work against (1/2) rho |Q|^3 / A^2 with the same refill and submergence coefficients the thrust uses

checks.name: the actuator supplies at least what the jet carries away
checks.note: 45.41 J of signed mechanical work against 14.94 J pumped

checks.name: internal-torque centre-of-mass drift converges at first order
checks.note: |drift| at dt = [0.002, 0.001, 0.0005, 0.00025]: ['3.738e-03', '1.793e-03', '8.885e-04', '4.389e-04'].  The drift is truncation, not a broken momentum balance: it is proportional to dt and vanishes with it.

checks.name: RK4 at the same step conserves it to near machine precision
checks.note: 4.457e-09 m against 1.793e-03 m for the project's first-order scheme at the same dt -- a factor of 402395

checks.name: gannet: 8 s of gait in a vacuum moves its centre of mass
checks.note: 1.51 mm at the project's dt = 0.004, 0.38 mm at 0.001, so the drift converges at order 1.00.  As a fraction of the 4.8 m a full-marks land segment covers, 0.031%.

checks.name: beetle: 8 s of gait in a vacuum moves its centre of mass
checks.note: 12.59 mm at the project's dt = 0.004, 3.10 mm at 0.001, so the drift converges at order 1.01.  As a fraction of the 4.8 m a full-marks land segment covers, 0.262%.

checks.name: teal: 8 s of gait in a vacuum moves its centre of mass
checks.note: 732.12 mm at the project's dt = 0.004, 284.95 mm at 0.001, so the drift converges at order 0.68.  As a fraction of the 4.8 m a full-marks land segment covers, 15.252%.

checks.name: medusa: 8 s of gait in a vacuum moves its centre of mass
checks.note: 0.59 mm at the project's dt = 0.004, 0.15 mm at 0.001, so the drift converges at order 1.01.  As a fraction of the 4.8 m a full-marks land segment covers, 0.012%.

checks.name: and the worst plan's drift converges at first order
checks.note: teal is the worst at 15.25% of a scored segment, and its order is 0.68.  An order of 1 means a smaller step fixes it; an order below 1 means the trajectory is changing under refinement rather than converging, and a smaller step does not.

layers.title: controller
layers.adds: the identified basis against the machine

checks.name: twist_of(c) equals A^T c
doubling the command doubles the response
checks.note: a central difference about the base gait, so any drift independent of the command cancels; what is left is the nonlinearity of the parameter-to-twist map at the 0.35 probe scale the identification uses

checks.name: and does not change its direction
checks.note: cosine between the response to c and to 2c

checks.name: the machine delivers the twist the basis predicts
checks.note: relative error 0.271 on the same body the basis was fitted on.  This is not graded against a closed form because there isn't one; the tolerance is 1.0, i.e. 'the command did something rather than nothing'.  What the number is worth is in experiments/rank_threshold, which measures the identification's own reproducibility.
